text:
SRM Valliammai Engineering College (SRMVEC), an Autonomous Institution, was established on September 9, 1999 (09.09.1999) under the Valliammai Educational Society with the vision "Educate to excel in social transformation". It currently conducts 11 Under Graduate courses and 9 Post Graduate courses. The college has highly qualified, dynamic and dedicated renowned faculty from both academic and industrial backgrounds, and students bring laurels to the college by securing university ranks.

The campus is situated in an extent of about 13.35 acres (the homepage says 13.5 acres) by the side of NH 45, between Tambaram and Chengalpattu. The serene atmosphere with surrounding greenery is conducive to the pursuit of higher studies. The college functions from a multi-storey building complex of 59,000 square metres. It has 5 multi-storeyed Academic Blocks and 2 Workshop Blocks.

SRMVEC is part of the SRM Group of Educational Institutions, sponsored by the Valliammai Society. The Valliammai Society was founded by Dr. T.R. Paarivendhar, a well-known educationist, in the name of his mother Tmt. R. Valliammai, under whose care and guidance he attained greater heights in his personal development and whose ideals continue to inspire him.

The college was granted autonomous status by UGC, New Delhi and Anna University, Chennai. It is approved by AICTE and affiliated with Anna University, offering programmes in Engineering & Technology, Management, and Computer Applications.

Dr. M. Murugan, M.E., Ph.D. is the Principal of SRM Valliammai Engineering College and Professor in the ECE department. Education: B.E. in Electronics & Communication Engineering from University of Madras (1989); Masters in Electronics & Telecommunication Engineering (specialization Microwave) from Government College of Engineering, Pune (2001); Ph.D. from University of Pune (Aug 2010). Experience: over 33 years in teaching and administration - Lecturer, Assistant Professor and HOD of Electronics Engineering at P.R.E.C, Loni (1990-2003); Assistant Professor & Professor and HOD of E&TC at Vishwakarma Institute of Information Technology, Pune (2003-2010). Interests: Communication Engineering, Microwave, OptiCom, SatCom, EMI&C.
Achievements: life member of IETE, ISTE, IEI, ISOI, SEMCEI, CSI, ISCA and SSI; over 150 technical papers; four patents filed; author of four textbooks ("Mobile Communication Systems", "Communication Systems", "Optical & Microwave Communication", "Wave Theory & Antenna"). Convener of International Conferences ICSA-2019 and ICSA-2021 and National Conferences NCMMC-2013 and 2015 at SRMVEC. Approved PG teacher and Ph.D. supervisor of Anna University and Sathyabhama University; ten scholars completed, four currently guided. Awards: ISTE "Anna University" National Award for Outstanding Academic (2016); Life Time Achievement Award by NGI, Coimbatore (2018); IETE Prof. K. Sreenivasan Memorial Award (2020); Institution of Engineers (India) TNSC Academic Excellence Award (2022).

section: Academics > Faculty of Engineering & Technology > Department of Cyber Security
text:
Programme: B.E. Cyber Security (Bachelor of Cyber Security Engineering). The department started in 2020 with an annual intake of 60. It covers network security, ethical hacking, cryptography and risk management, with a curriculum aligned to Anna University and AICTE updates. It has well-qualified faculty with industry-relevant specializations, enables interaction with cyber experts, and builds long-term industry relationships for "leads and pathways" to high-tech careers.
Vision: to devise captivating and unique teaching practices that discover the trained talent and inherent competences of young minds to evolve as humane professional engineers. Mission: provide challenging ventures to compete with international talent; act as a motivational hub for practical knowledge with latest technology and research publications; promote industry-institute harmony for international reputation.
Short-term goals: promote R&D, aim for 100% results with high scores, encourage research papers, equip with latest technology, motivate internship projects. Long-term goals: host international conferences, get government/MNC funded projects, sign MoUs with MNC/international companies, set up a research centre.
PEOs: PEO1 top performance in higher education and research; PEO2 solid foundation in mathematics, science and engineering; PEO3 innovate novel solutions for common man; PEO4 ethical entrepreneurs; PEO5 conducive learning environment for professional career.
PSOs: PSO1 team-oriented software solutions for business and society; PSO2 hands-on programming skills and decision making; PSO3 logical analysis of real-world problems with ethics; PSO4 teamwork applying technology to business/personal situations.
(Note: the website's Cyber Security vision/PEO/PSO text refers to "Computer Science Engineers" and looks copied from the CSE department.)

Programme: B.E. Medical Electronics, established 2019. It applies electronics and instrumentation to healthcare - medical devices, diagnostic equipment and health-monitoring systems. Faculty specialize in Instrumentation, Biomedical Engineering, Medical Electronics and Applied Electronics. Students get exposure to real clinical environments: visits to the in-house hospital, SIMS Hospital (Vadapalani) and SRM Medical College Hospital and Research Centre (Kattankulathur); hospital internship is mandatory.
